content:
Correcting the two-digit block:
\[
10\cdot45+9\cdot45=855.
\]
Then
\[
S(2019)=45+855+\bigl(100\cdot45+2(90\cdot45)\bigr)+\bigl(1000+3(100\cdot45)\bigr)+140=28140.
\]
Since
\[
28140\equiv 6 \pmod 9,
\]
we need the next digit sums to add \(3 \pmod 9\). Checking:
\[
2020: 4,\quad 2021: 5,\quad 2022: 6,\quad 2023: 7,\quad 2024: 8.
\]
Their cumulative contribution is \(4+5+6+7+8=30\equiv 3\pmod 9\), so
\[
S(2024)\equiv 6+3\equiv 0\pmod 9.
\]
No smaller \(k>2019\) works.

\[
\boxed{2024}
\]
